name: Distillates (petroleum), naphtha-raffinate pyrolyzate-derived, gasoline-blending; Low boiling point thermally cracked naphtha; [The complex combination of hydrocarbons obtained by the pyrolysis fractionation at 816°C (1500°F) of naphtha and raffinate.  It consists predominantly of hydrocarbons having a carbon number of C9 and boiling at approximately 204°C (400°F).]
